## 41 · Reference — Open action-items digest (inactive)
Weekdays 08:00 → **Forms · List Tasks** (`status: Open`) → group by *Assigned To* → **one email per assignee** in the CCF-reminder style (`JLkRRVF6n5Kcwswy`).

**Safety:** `recipientOverride` in *Workflow Configuration* is **dbinns@team-group.com** — every digest goes there (subject prefixed `[TEST → <assignee>]`) until George/HR approve real recipients; then blank it. `portalUrl` = the tier's portal `/exec` URL for deep links (placeholder). `minTasks` lets you skip people with fewer open items.
Placeholders: `<<LIST_TASKS_WORKFLOW_ID>>` (imported 15), `<<PORTAL_EXEC_URL>>`, `<<ERROR_WORKFLOW_ID>>`. Gmail credential = team "Gmail account".

value.actor: ={{ { id: 'n8n:ref-open-tasks-digest', email: 'efx-bot@team-group.com', display: 'Ref Open Tasks Digest (n8n)' } }}

parameters.content: **Forms · List Tasks** (sub-workflow 15) → `n8n_listTasks(actor, { status:'Open' })` → `{ tasks[], count }`. Add `formType` here to digest only one kind (e.g. `jr_title`).

**Group by Assigned To** — one item per assignee with their tasks (oldest first, age in days, checklist items, draft flag). **Build Email Content** runs once per item and renders the CCF-style HTML; when `recipientOverride` is set the real assignee is only shown in the subject.
